summary: Lead lifecycle transitions are tracked through opportunity categories. The live site presents leads by state: new registrations (73), inadequate (53), requires improvement (2,904), not yet inspected (20,989). The search page filters by these opportunity types. The lead-list page presents structured lead data. The directory leads test verifies data integrity across states. The CQC pipeline tracks provider state changes between snapshots. The production product specification (product_specification.md) documents the lead lifecycle.
assertions: Live site lead states: new_90, inadequate, requires_improvement, not_yet_inspected
Search and lead-list pages filter by lifecycle state
CQC pipeline tracks state transitions between snapshots
Directory leads test verifies multi-state data integrity
